read_first: only the issuer, team, people, operation or institutional owners whose authority, availability or state changes the commitment
write_order: resolve the real institutional, contractual or operational action first
update project/contract/mission lifecycle record to mirror that resolved authority
for an active or blocked commitment, set the next exact review boundary unless a referenced exact operation/domain process owns it
when a commitment completes, fails or is cancelled, close its lifecycle record and evaluate lawful successor actions immediately
create no mission, transfer, team, permission or resource merely from a planning record
invariants: Projects record resolved planning lifecycle and never substitute for institutional authority.
OOC proposals and wishlists do not become active missions or assignments.
A project may become authorized only after the actual authority, staffing, obligations and blockers are resolved in their owning systems.
Formation of a team does not automatically create a mission.
Active and blocked commitments cannot be timeless: they carry a next_due_at or reference an exact operation/domain process that owns the next boundary.
Commitment records do not duplicate rosters, command, equipment, injuries, property or other domain-owned facts.
Completion, failure or cancellation wakes the responsible autonomous owner to evaluate a successor instead of leaving stale active state.
